# zlib-ng / fuzzer_example_small

zlib-ng's own fuzz target `fuzzer_example_small` ([source](source/fuzzer_example_small.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over zlib-ng (zlib-ng/zlib-ng at 1579085c).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: deflate then inflate with 1-byte in/out buffers; output must memcmp-equal the input.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zlib-ng at commit 1579085c.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- Every deflate/inflate call must return Z_OK (or Z_STREAM_END where expected) ([lines 9-14](source/fuzzer_example_small.c#L9-L14)): exit(1); not confirmed in the binary.
- deflate then inflate with 1-byte in/out buffers; output must memcmp-equal the input ([lines 86-89](source/fuzzer_example_small.c#L86-L89)): exit(1); not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch zlib-ng` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzzer_example_small.plain` | 155,064 | `9465dce2ada79abd3da9c99887b3658d63c8dba3808e2385bff4d2bacaedb03f` |
| ubsan | `fuzzer_example_small.ubsan` | 152,584 | `ea2abe2322b65a22e471ba7575f39cc8a3c225521e76e56724e4de3fb91d07ec` |
| asan | `fuzzer_example_small.asan` | 820,952 | `6c46646483772994e37c34eb079d4dfccbf7c47ad2dfb0a5a949c4f434275cd9` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzzer_example_small.asan-ubsan` | 796,856 | `b2e03bee0d066f13753fb3d3074ca8ec54bb799e0c1d29e44258336aa2dca16c` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
